hero.titleLine2: and Cursor, ChatGPT, any MCP client
hero.lead: Give your AI agent a real Onet mailbox. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail over IMAP with the password you already use, in every MCP client rather than just one.
hero.answer: Claude cannot reach Onet Poczta on its own. MCPEmails is a hosted MCP server that connects it over IMAP at imap.poczta.onet.pl on port 993, signing in with your full address and your Onet password, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can read, search, send and organize that mail. Onet keeps each protocol behind its own switch in the mailbox settings, so IMAP and SMTP have to be unblocked under Konto Główne first, and with two-step verification on, mail programs sign in with a hasło do aplikacji generated in Onet Konto. From 5 May 2026 Onet allows mail programs over IMAP only, having withdrawn POP3, and its notice says holders of perpetual accounts keep IMAP at no extra charge. One inbox is free, forever.

method.title: How Onet Poczta connects: IMAP, per-protocol switches, app passwords
method.body: Onet serves IMAP at imap.poczta.onet.pl on port 993 with SSL and SMTP at smtp.poczta.onet.pl on port 465 with SSL, and its settings page reminds you that the account name is the whole address, such as jan.onetowy@onet.pl. The IMAP server advertises AUTH=PLAIN, AUTH=LOGIN and AUTH=XOAUTH2. Before any of that matters, the protocols have to be on: Onet manages IMAP, POP and SMTP individually in the mailbox settings, under Ustawienia (the cog on the left), Konto, the Konto Główne tab, where each protocol has a tile with a switch. The password depends on one account setting. With two-step verification (weryfikacja dwuetapowa) off, your Onet password signs mail programs in. With it on, Onet says app passwords are necessary, and you generate a hasło do aplikacji under Bezpieczeństwo in the Onet Konto settings. And since 5 May 2026 Onet's notice to POP3 users applies: access from mail programs is possible over IMAP only, fetching from external accounts was switched off on the same date, and holders of perpetual accounts (konta wieczyste) can use IMAP without additional fees.

setup.p: Sign up at mcpemails.com. The free plan connects one inbox forever and does not ask for a card.

setup.h: Unblock IMAP and SMTP under Konto Główne
setup.p: Sign in at poczta.onet.pl, click the cog icon (Ustawienia) on the bar to the left of the mailbox, choose Konto, then the Konto Główne tab. Each protocol has its own tile with a switch. Turn on IMAP and SMTP; POP is no longer offered for mail programs. Onet's Thunderbird guide says the same: make sure every protocol your client needs is unblocked before you try to sign in.

setup.h: With two-step verification on, generate a hasło do aplikacji
setup.p: Onet states that app passwords are necessary when you use two-step verification together with mail clients. Open Bezpieczeństwo in the Onet Konto settings (konto.onet.pl), create an app password and name it MCPEmails. Deleting it later ends that program's access, which is the clean way to disconnect. With two-step verification off, your ordinary Onet password works as it is.

setup.h: Paste the address and password into MCPEmails, then the MCP URL into your AI
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP, enter the full address such as nazwa@onet.pl, and paste the password. The Onet hosts and ports are prefilled and were verified from a live TLS connection. Then drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.

gotchas.h: Every protocol has its own switch, and a blocked one looks like a bad password
gotchas.p: Onet's protocol page is short and specific: IMAP, POP and SMTP are each switched on or off by the slider on their tile under Ustawienia, Konto, Konto Główne. A mailbox that has only ever been used in the browser or the app can have them off, and while a protocol is blocked the server refuses correct credentials with nothing to say why. It is also possible to have IMAP on and SMTP off, which reads as a reading-works-sending-fails connection. Check the tiles before you reset anything.

gotchas.h: 5 May 2026: IMAP only for mail programs, and external-account fetching gone
gotchas.p: Onet's notice to POP3 users is dated 17 February 2026 and names 5 May 2026 as the day mail programs such as Thunderbird and Outlook can connect over IMAP only. The same notice says fetching from external accounts into Onet Poczta was switched off on that date, and that holders of perpetual accounts (konta wieczyste) can use IMAP without additional fees. The webmail and the mobile app stay free for everyone. If an old client profile uses POP3, it has to move to IMAP; MCPEmails only ever used IMAP, so nothing changes here, but the account itself has to be one Onet allows in mail programs. Onet's package comparison is at oferta.poczta.onet.pl.

gotchas.h: Two-step verification and mail programs need an app password
gotchas.p: Unlike Interia, Onet does not block mail programs when you turn on two-step verification; it moves them to a separate credential. Its help calls app passwords necessary when two-step verification and mail clients are used together, and generates them under Bezpieczeństwo in Onet Konto. The trap is that your browser password is then silently the wrong one, and the refusal looks identical to a typo. Onet also recommends an individual app password per program even without two-step verification, which is good practice: deleting one ends that program's access and nothing else.

gotchas.h: No IDLE and no MOVE, so filing and freshness both cost extra round trips
gotchas.p: Onet's IMAP banner advertises SASL-IR and LITERAL+ but not IDLE, so new mail is discovered by polling rather than pushed on an open connection. It also omits MOVE and UIDPLUS, so filing a message runs as a copy, a flag update and an expunge, and the new id of the copy has to be found by searching the destination folder. Neither is fatal; bulk organizing is slower than it looks, and a move is not atomic.

limits: Mail programs connect over IMAP only since 5 May 2026, on the terms Onet sets for the account; its notice exempts perpetual accounts from additional fees. This is a provider rule and no MCP server, ours included, can work around it.
A message is capped at 50 MB in both directions, so a large file is refused at send time rather than trimmed.
SPECIAL-USE is absent, so Sent, Drafts and Trash are matched by name rather than by role, and without MOVE a move is a copy plus delete. Name the folder in the instruction if an agent cannot find it.

faq.q: Does Claude work with Onet Poczta?
faq.a: Not directly. Claude has no built-in Onet connector and cannot open an IMAP connection by itself. Connecting an MCP server such as MCPEmails to your onet.pl or op.pl mailbox over IMAP gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection works in Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients, provided IMAP and SMTP are unblocked on the account.

faq.q: What are the Onet IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: IMAP is imap.poczta.onet.pl on port 993 with SSL. SMTP is smtp.poczta.onet.pl on port 465, also SSL. The username is your complete address and the password is your Onet password, or a hasło do aplikacji if two-step verification is on. Both hosts were confirmed from a live TLS connection and match Onet's settings page, which warns that a mail app may suggest different server names.

faq.q: Why is my Onet password rejected in a mail client?
faq.a: Three reasons, in this order. The protocol is blocked: open Ustawienia, Konto, Konto Główne and switch IMAP and SMTP on. Two-step verification is on: mail programs then need a hasło do aplikacji from Bezpieczeństwo in Onet Konto. Or the client still uses POP3, which Onet withdrew for mail programs on 5 May 2026.

Yes. Onet's help describes app passwords (hasła do aplikacji) for signing in to Onet Poczta from external programs, generated under Bezpieczeństwo in the Onet Konto settings, and calls them necessary when two-step verification and mail clients are used together. A deleted app password immediately ends that program's access.

Onet's own notice says that from 5 May 2026 mail programs connect over IMAP only and that holders of perpetual accounts can use IMAP without additional fees; it does not spell out the terms for other accounts on that page, and its package comparison lives at oferta.poczta.onet.pl. If your IMAP login is refused with the protocols unblocked and the right password, check what your account's package allows there.

faq.q: Is my Onet mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from Onet over IMAP for each request and handed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained.
